customer: I'm moving to North Carolina for a new job in a couple of weeks and I simply don't have time to drive my electric car to one of your locations to sell it. Every place I've called wants me to jump through hoops. Is there any way to get this done without me hauling the car somewhere?
agent: Congratulations on the new job, and I understand how hectic a move can be. Our Home pickup service is available in every state we serve: a Northwind specialist can come to your home or office, inspect the car, and complete the sale on the spot at no charge, bringing the paperwork and paying you by bank draft. You can book home pickup when you schedule your appraisal. Just have everything on the appointment checklist ready and park the car where it can be inspected in daylight.
